stories.headline: China Launches Maritime Enforcement Operation East of Taiwan — First Time Beijing Names Time, Place, Legal Basis
stories.thesis: China announced a maritime traffic law enforcement operation east of Taiwan on June 6, the same day as Japan-Philippines boundary talks. Markets dismiss as posturing but the operational transparency is unprecedented — Beijing has never publicly named a specific time/place/legal basis for asserting control in these waters.

stories.headline: Iran Strikes Kuwait With 7 Ballistic Missiles — Regional War Expands, Diplomatic Track Dead
stories.thesis: Iran struck Kuwait, a major OPEC producer and US ally, with 7 ballistic missiles. Hormuz blockade holds. Iran denies nuclear talks. Markets priced a ceasefire that is actively being contradicted by kinetic activity.

stories.headline: Ukraine Hits St. Petersburg With 250+ Drones During PMEF — Military Base, Physics Institute Destroyed
stories.thesis: Ukraine struck Russia's second city during its flagship economic forum, hitting a naval mine-torpedo base and the Fock Physics Research Institute. Putin rejected peace talks the same day. Russian budget deficit hits 6.01T rubles.

stories.headline: Bitcoin Free Fall — Saylor Liquidates, ETFs Bleed, 200-Week MA in Play
stories.thesis: BTC drops 5.5% to $61.3K as Strategy sells $2.5M — psychologically devastating for the 'never sell' narrative. $11.5B unrealized loss. ETF outflows at record. 200-week MA support at risk.

stories.headline: Google Signs $920M/Month AI Compute Deal With SpaceX/xAI — IPO Demand Surges
stories.thesis: Google locked in $920M/month AI compute with SpaceX. SpaceX IPO (June 12) is 2x oversubscribed at $75B. Contradiction: SpaceX lost $4.28B on $4.69B revenue in Q1 — they lose money on every dollar but are valued at $1.8T+.

stories.headline: Zcash Soundness Researcher Now Audits Monero — XMR -10%, Recovery Underway
stories.thesis: The researcher who found Zcash's soundness bug now targets Monero. XMR crashed -10% then recovered to +4.77%. Core contradiction: privacy coins can't prove absence of bugs. Zcash was 'battle-tested' too. XMR has no transparent fallback.
